sentences.text: KAR CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners files a memo seeking withdrawal of the Criminal Petition.

The memo so filed reads as follows:
"MEMO FOR WITHDRAWAL The petitioners state as under:-
1.

They have sought for discharge of the offences alleged in CC No.1288/2023 for the offences punishable under sections 498A, 504, 323, 506 read with section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under section 3, 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, in the Court of the JMFC II, Shivamogga,
2.
In terms of the judgment dated October 23, 2025, the Hon'ble Court of the JMFC II, Shivamogga, in CC No.1288/2023 has been pleased to acquit the petitioners of the alleged offences.
Wherefore the petitioners pray this Hon'ble Court to be pleased to dismiss the petition as the same has become infructuous, for the ends of justice."
In terms of memo, the Criminal Petition is disposed as withdrawn.

Sd/-
